applicabilityBasis.summary: DEURO is promoted for euro payments and targets EUR through collateralized borrowing. Its website states that there is no central issuer or person controlling the protocol, while its documentation describes no hard peg and user-created debt positions. No obligation by an identified issuer to redeem for currency or bank-deposit monetary value was established. Payment use together with that unresolved statutory issuer-obligation element supports unclear GENIUS applicability.

genius.notes: The dEURO Association operates the information site and is identified by the documentation imprint in Zug, Switzerland. It is not assigned as issuerEntity because the website expressly disclaims protocol control. Reviewed creation and liquidation mechanics involve crypto collateral and debt repayment, not an identified issuer promise of EUR cash redemption. This follows the zchf-frankencoin unclear applicability precedent. The sibling ZCHF legal analysis is contextual evidence and is not treated as a legal opinion on DEURO. Enforcement and disclosure flags are omitted where the scoped evidence does not establish a separate finding.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: The public regulator resources, directories, exact-name Federal Register query and project disclosures checked on 2026-10-28 did not identify a GENIUS permitted issuer approval, state qualification, official pending application or registered foreign-issuer exception for DEURO or the dEURO Association. No named GENIUS issuance path was established in the reviewed project disclosures. This bounded finding does not rule out confidential, unindexed or differently named filings and does not treat general bank or virtual currency licenses as GENIUS permission.
